task.ques: Look up the latest stable release version of Vuex and find out when it was published.

claude.final_answer: FINAL: Vuex’s latest stable release is 4.1.0, published October 14, 2022. GitHub lists v4.1.0 as the newest tag with “Oct 14, 2022” (https://github.com/vuejs/vuex/tags), and Snyk’s publication history confirms “4.1.0 — 14 Oct, 2022” (https://security.snyk.io/package/npm/vuex/versions). Evidence: final.png.
